Jungle.description: Adapted deeply to the deep, tangled canopies of the Mwangi jungles.

features.name: Jungle Anadi
features.tldr: You gain a climb Speed equal to your land Speed and a bonus against venom.

Spore.description: Tuned to symbiotic fungus and deep-earth spores.

features.name: Spore Anadi
features.tldr: You emit protective spores that grant resistance to poison and environmental decay.
